remarks: Welcome to this meticulously maintained, bright, and spacious end-unit townhome in the sought-after Leefair complex. Boasting a comfortable and inviting floor plan, this home offers an abundance of natural light and a sense of privacy that's hard to beat. The heart of the home features a lovely white eat-in kitchen perfect for casual dining. A formal dining room is ideal for hosting guests, while the cozy den with built-ins offers a great space for work or relaxation. The expansive living room is highlighted by a wood-burning fireplace, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. Sliding doors lead to a professionally landscaped private terrace-your own peaceful outdoor retreat. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite offers a serene space to unwind. Two additional well-sized bedrooms and a full hall bath round out the upper level, providing ample space for family or guests. The lower level, though unfinished, provides abundant storage and includes a large walk-in seasonal closet, perfect for keeping your home organized. 2-car attached garage with easy access directly into the kitchen. Numerous updates to the complex, including a new roof, roads, and fences-all paid off by the current owners. This home combines comfort, convenience, and peaceful living in a vibrant community. Don't miss the opportunity to make this beautiful townhome yours!
